Horsensklyngen is a healthcare cluster (sundhedsklynge) operating within [[region-midtjylland|Region Midtjylland]] in Denmark. It is actively monitored in the national quality reports for the treatment of [[atrieflimren|atrial fibrillation]] (AFDK), published by the Danish Regions' Clinical Quality Development Programme (RKKP) and the Danish Healthcare Quality Institute. The cluster is significant for its strong performance in several clinical quality indicators, frequently meeting or exceeding national standards and development goals.

In the 2024 AFDK report, Horsensklyngen demonstrated high compliance with Indicator 1, which measures the timely initiation of anticoagulation therapy for newly diagnosed patients, achieving a result of 92.9% and thereby fulfilling the national standard [^src1]. The cluster also showed notable results across other indicators, including treatment coverage over 1-year and 2-year periods [^src2], and annual P-creatinine measurements for patients on DOAC treatment [^src4]. Furthermore, data on severe bleeding and heart failure within one year of a new diagnosis highlights the cluster's patient outcomes compared to national averages [^src6] [^src7].

By the 2025 reporting period, Horsensklyngen continued to be a top performer. For [[indikator-3|Indicator 3]], which assesses the clinical practice of performing TSH measurements at the time of a new AF diagnosis to rule out thyroid disease, Horsensklyngen achieved the highest performance among all health clusters at 93.1%, placing it very close to the national development goal [^src9]. This contrasts with lower-performing clusters, such as [[sundhedsklynge-soenderjylland|Sundhedsklynge Sønderjylland]], illustrating the geographic variation in target fulfillment across the Danish healthcare system [^src13]. The cluster's data is also integral to national mapping of AF outcomes, such as the incidence of ischemic stroke ([[indikator-5|Indicator 5]]), contributing to the broader epidemiological and quality improvement strategies in Danish cardiology [^src4].

## Claims

### performance
- Variationen i målopfyldelse blandt sundhedsklynger strækker sig fra 52,9% i Sundhedsklynge Sønderjylland til 87,9% i Horsensklyngen [^src1] (indikator-3, sundhedsklynge-soenderjylland, horsensklyngen)
- Horsensklyngen ligger højest med 93,1%, tæt på udviklingsmålet [^src1] (horsensklyngen)
